title: Keep the C parser for the large-file path

messages.author: maintainer-a
messages.body: We considered replacing the parser with Rust. The prototype was about twice as slow on large files, so we should keep the C parser for this path.

messages.author: maintainer-b
messages.body: Agreed. The Rust rewrite was reverted after the performance result. Keep the implementation in parser/core.c and link this discussion from future changes.
